The voice is enthusiastic and clear. (2) A distinct, sharp 'snip-snip' sound of metallic scissors cutting through hair triggers a brief shift in focus, synchronized with the visual cut. (3) The female narrator's voice continues, maintaining a high pitch and rapid pace. The music remains consistent in the background. (4) A low-frequency, rhythmic 'thump-thump' heartbeat sound effect enters, accompanied by soft, high-pitched cooing and babbling from a baby. (5) The female narrator transitions to a more conversational, indoor tone with slight room resonance as she describes waiting. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the speech to remain the primary signal. (6) A sharp, digital 'ding' notification sound effect plays twice, mimicking a phone alert. (7) Sound of heavy breathing/panting and the mechanical thud of a car door opening creates a shift to a noisy urban environment with faint engine idling. (8) A new male voice is heard, expressing surprise with a moderate pitch and natural inflection. The female responds with laughter and excited speech. (9) The audio concludes with a final swell of the BGM and a playful vocal exchange ending in a comedic tone.
